name: FreeGames
author: Malvinarum
short: Tracks and notifies about limited-time free game giveaways.
description: A RedBot cog that uses the GamerPower API to check for and announce new, time-limited free game giveaways (like those from Epic Games Store) to a designated channel.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild IDs and a list of giveaway IDs that have already been announced in each guild to prevent spamming duplicate notifications. No personal data is stored.
